armGroups.label: Adalimumab Every Week (EW)
armGroups.description: Adalimumab ew for 12 weeks (160 mg at Week 0; 80 mg at Week 2; and 40 mg ew from Week 4 to Week 12).

armGroups.label: Placebo/Placebo
armGroups.description: Participants randomized to receive placebo in Period 1 received placebo every week from Week 12 to Week 35 in Period 2 (up to 24 weeks).

armGroups.label: Adalimumab Every Week (EW)/Placebo
armGroups.description: Participants randomized to receive adalimumab ew in Period 1 were re-randomized to receive placebo ew from Week 12 to Week 35 in Period 2 (up to 24 weeks).

armGroups.label: Adalimumab Every Week (EW)/ Adalimumab Every Other Week (EOW)
armGroups.description: Participants randomized to receive adalimumab ew in Period 1 were re-randomized to receive 40 mg adalimumab eow from Week 12 to Week 35 in Period 2; placebo injections were administered eow from Week 13 to Week 35 (up to 24 weeks).

armGroups.label: Adalimumab Every Week (EW)/Adalimumab Every Week (EW)
armGroups.description: Participants randomized to receive adalimumab ew in Period 1 were re-randomized to receive 40 mg adalimumab ew from Week 12 to Week 35 in Period 2 (up to 24 weeks).

interventions.name: adalimumab

participantFlowModule.recruitmentDetails: Participants ≥ 18 years of age with HS for at least 1 year prior to Baseline and HS lesions present in at least 2 distinct anatomical areas (one of which must be at least Hurley Stage II or III) who had experienced inadequate response to ≥ 90 day treatment of oral antibiotics for HS were eligible for enrolment in the study.
